scope: known and reproducible defects plus unresolved acceptance gaps, not exhaustive discovery proof

bugs.summary: Global netifd reload during Wi-Fi enable could interrupt LTE and hang MT76
bugs.root_cause: Previous native AP helper called network reload even though hardware field logs forbid it
bugs.protection: WiFi prepare helper has no network reload, radio up/down or reboot; UCI-only and manual reboot

bugs.summary: Fresh flash leaves AP disabled with encryption none; missing secure onboarding
bugs.root_cause: Firstboot intentionally secures AP but GUI previously lacked safe WPA2 completion path
bugs.protection: WPA2 configuration plus explicit next-boot preparation; external phone test still required

bugs.summary: mt76 MCU timeout/hung AP can stop connectivity
bugs.root_cause: Hardware driver/radio reconfiguration hangs have occurred; kernel fix and long-run recovery not proven
bugs.protection: Source mitigates trigger: AP activation is UCI-only with no global network reload, wifi down/up, modem power-cycle or automatic restart; mt76 MCU timeout/root cause is NOT proven fixed. LAB compilation permitted after real source tests, but firmware release/physical flash needs driver UAT and recovery proof.

bugs.summary: SSID status depended on hexdump not included on minimal router
bugs.root_cause: Optional binary dependency in RPC status path
bugs.protection: Use libubox JSON escaping, allow legacy hex response in frontend

bugs.summary: Unspecified radio0.disabled was incorrectly considered disabled by PowerShell v2
bugs.root_cause: Script demanded literal 0 instead of accepting absent UCI default
bugs.protection: Allow unset or 0 for radio; keep AP fail-closed until WPA2 ready

bugs.summary: Main Wi-Fi controls were placed in Network Overview instead of Wi-Fi
bugs.root_cause: Mismatched HTML data-group and menu location
bugs.protection: Menu-to-control and DOM IDs tested

bugs.summary: Configuration rollback cannot recover a hung MT76 kernel state
bugs.root_cause: UCI backup restores persistent settings but cannot safely force driver reset on sole router
bugs.protection: No automatic runtime reload; owner-controlled recovery and test after reboot

bugs.summary: Earlier flash had no IP on usb0 or gateway and no internet
bugs.root_cause: Modem RNDIS and netifd startup timing, route management and APN readiness
bugs.protection: Current router SIM1 + HTTPS204 works; new binary coldboot UAT not done

bugs.summary: SIM absent was surfaced as APN configuration failure on manual SIM2 trial
bugs.root_cause: Manual SIM switch applied APN without first proving CPIN READY
bugs.protection: SIM readiness required before APN/PDP

bugs.summary: Manual SIM rollback risked additional power cycle and an unclear status
bugs.root_cause: Owner manager already attempts verified single rollback; wrapper could repeat it
bugs.protection: Single canonical LTE manager, explicit rollback verified/unverified

bugs.summary: Re-selecting the already active SIM could hard-cycle a working modem
bugs.root_cause: Manual CLI path always started selected modem
bugs.protection: Exact same slot no-op

bugs.summary: GPIO46 selector polarity only proven for SIM1, not a functioning SIM2
bugs.root_cause: Single router; SIM2 field trial was absent/not registered
bugs.protection: No SIM2 hardware PASS without inserted SIM and live registration

bugs.summary: Concurrent modem AT commands may block USB transport and SMS
bugs.root_cause: Modem command channel is shared, not independently scalable
bugs.protection: One shared modem manager/port lock and bounded response; live stability pending

bugs.summary: Add-on menu calls were sent to wrong services RPC methods
bugs.root_cause: Frontend used veci.v2.services for addonProfiles and mutations; implementation belongs to veci.v2.addon
bugs.protection: One canonical startup provider and distinct addon profiles owner; both exercised against real HTML IDs by Node VM

bugs.summary: Mobile navigation UI caused browser session regression test failure
bugs.root_cause: Fixture lacked body.classList used by new navigation
bugs.protection: Authenticated login/logout/browser DOM regression

bugs.summary: Every interactive menu has not yet passed end-to-end browser UAT
bugs.root_cause: Static handlers and RPC methods may exist while actual device actions still fail
bugs.protection: Runtime browser E2E must check each visible action and real backend effect

bugs.summary: SMS object registered while feature disabled/not proven for inbox and send
bugs.root_cause: Backend availability does not prove actual modem SMS read and delivery
bugs.protection: Real modem send/receive/read/delete with permission and privacy checks

bugs.summary: 31 source module receipts have outdated SHA256 and release source gate blocks build
bugs.root_cause: New implementation and tests changed without evidence renewal
bugs.protection: Renewed actual native CI source receipts for all 39 active modules, 175 scoped test executions, commit e275946043ceebce061a97042041620c0a80edf7, GitHub workflow run 45758892212; exact log and source hashes independently verified

bugs.summary: Final SquashFS feature audit did not require new Wi-Fi activation helper
bugs.root_cause: One manifest entry checked RPC provider but not its installed helper
bugs.protection: Exact ROM SHA256 mapping includes helper binary

bugs.summary: Signed candidate, trust anchor and sysupgrade -T not yet verified on device
bugs.root_cause: Source build or packaging alone cannot prove flash safety
bugs.protection: Require manifest + ucert signature + sysupgrade dry run and exact board

bugs.summary: 72-hour LTE and Wi-Fi reliability not tested on the new firmware
bugs.root_cause: Current short check and source simulation cannot prove soak stability
bugs.protection: 72-hour time series with independent LAN/Wi-Fi/LTE checks

bugs.summary: Host native UCI/libubox regression suite cannot run on current andre-nas image
bugs.root_cause: json-c development headers missing; GitHub CI installs pinned dependencies
bugs.protection: Require GitHub CI actual native suite result, not skipped test

bugs.summary: All 39 modules have source declarations but zero new-binary hardware acceptances
bugs.root_cause: Physical acceptance contract is separate from source feature inventory
bugs.protection: Per-module physical UAT must pass without bypass

bugs.summary: Windows PowerShell SSH stderr/CR could falsely abort router diagnostics
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell native stream handling and remote CR command transport
bugs.protection: Isolated SSH exit status, stdout sentinel and POSIX newline-safe remote script

bugs.summary: Firmware diagnostics assumed timeout/od/base64 were always available on BusyBox
bugs.root_cause: Minimal router lacks some standalone CLI binaries
bugs.protection: Use verified BusyBox applets, kernel CSPRNG UUID or native libubox; fail closed

bugs.summary: Services JS bound missing addon-read DOM ID and failed initialization
bugs.root_cause: Old service module constructed both startup and addon panels, but Add-on UI had migrated to addon-profiles-read; null.addEventListener threw before service init
bugs.protection: Single services owner binds startup-read; addon-profiles.js binds addon-profiles-read; actual DOM mock loads both modules and clicks buttons

bugs.summary: Release contract labeled WE2825-2SIM despite physical router being ZBT-WE5927-DSIM
bugs.root_cause: Legacy board_display survived migration to WE5927; board_id and target remained correct
bugs.protection: Board display WE5927-2SIM while canonical supported device stays zbtlink,zbt-we5927; no device-tree changes

bugs.summary: CI SSID test invoked Ubuntu dash even though libubox jshn requires BusyBox ash features
bugs.root_cause: Host fixture executed provider shebang using /bin/sh (dash); real router uses BusyBox ash, so host test falsely failed with exit 2
bugs.protection: Always invoke exact BusyBox ash in native host tests; CI latest run passed actual SSID and Wi-Fi UCI test

bugs.summary: Login/logout GUI regression fixture hardcoded RPC count and broke with new read-only SMS health check
bugs.root_cause: Test expected exactly six calls; new permitted read-only diagnostic introduced another before logout
bugs.protection: Verify exactly one session destroy and no unauthorized writes, rather than forbidding additional safe read-only telemetry
